relations.reason: Code-owned routing and termination surround bounded semantic specialist nodes.
Specialist isolation requires explicit context and state ownership.
Retrieved chunks inherit source scope, retention and deletion contracts.
Workflow route, retry, output and replay invariants need per-case evidence.
Delegation choice, state ownership and completion trajectory are release behavior.
Scope, persistence, isolation and deletion are observable data contracts.
Retrieval identity, ACL, lifecycle and citations require independent metrics.
Rejected and replayed actions must be tested as blocking safety cases.
Consequential Workflow nodes add authorization and external idempotency to pause/resume.
Promotion binds the exact behavior report that passed before deployment.
Remote topology must name durable Session, artifact and memory services.

decision_boundaries.tension: A model can choose semantic work, but fixed ordering, retry and termination must remain predictable.
decision_boundaries.resolution: Keep policy in Workflow edges and use a specialist only for bounded independent reasoning.
decision_boundaries.rejected_decision: Use an LLM coordinator for a route that is already a deterministic business rule.

decision_boundaries.tension: Artifacts, memory and retrieval can all make data model-visible but have different lifecycle owners.
decision_boundaries.resolution: Choose storage by scope and retention; add RAG only when ranked evidence and citations are required.
decision_boundaries.rejected_decision: Put every large or cross-session datum into a vector index.

decision_boundaries.tension: Evaluation detects unsafe behavior after execution, while policy must prevent the effect before execution.
decision_boundaries.resolution: Enforce authorization at runtime and use evaluation to prove the enforcement remains intact.
decision_boundaries.rejected_decision: Treat a passing safety eval as the mechanism that blocks a consequential tool call.

decision_boundaries.tension: Framework replay can restore control flow without guaranteeing one external effect.
decision_boundaries.resolution: Persist replay evidence and enforce action-ID idempotency in the side-effect service.
decision_boundaries.rejected_decision: Assume a resumed Session or consumed confirmation is a payment deduplication boundary.

decision_boundaries.tension: Deployment targets differ, but the Agent behavior being promoted must not silently fork.
decision_boundaries.resolution: Keep Agent and behavior contracts target-independent; vary only owned runtime and platform artifacts.
decision_boundaries.rejected_decision: Encode target-specific behavior branches inside the Agent implementation.
